l2.panel.note: Just a picture of an idea. Two weeks squeezed small, and no real scores.
l2.cal.label: The two weeks, day by day
l2.start.help: How easy it is to begin. Not how well it goes.
l2.skills.help: Skills grow each time you practise, whenever it happens.
l2.soccer.setUpHelp: The coach picks the times. A grown-up drives you.
l2.book.title: Your story
l2.day.label: {weekday} · {week}
l2.moment.snack.help: When you get home from school
l2.setup.stand.your: Your cello is out of its case.
l2.setup.music.your: Your music is open on the stand.
l2.setup.pillow.your: Your book is on your pillow.
l2.setup.table.your: Your book is on the kitchen table.
l2.d2: Tuesday. Soccer practice after school. The coach set the time, and your dad drives you.
l2.d3: Wednesday. Your friends are playing tag in the park.
l2.d4: Thursday. Rain! Soccer practice is cancelled.
l2.d5: Friday. A long week. You’re worn out.
l2.d6: Saturday. No school. Your match is at noon, then a family visit till late.
l2.d7: Sunday. A slow day at home.
l2.d8: Monday. Your friend’s birthday party is after school!
l2.d10.cello: Wednesday. Snap! A string on your cello broke.
l2.d10.reading: Wednesday. Oh no. Your book is still at school.
l2.d11: Thursday. Soccer, and the coach shows everyone a new passing trick.
l2.d12: Friday. Your cousins are coming for dinner.
l2.d13: Saturday. Match day again, then the family visit.
l2.d14: Sunday. The last day of the two weeks.
l2.fit.gone.snack: Practice runs late. You eat your snack in the car, so your moment doesn’t come today.
l2.fit.tired.bed: Soccer wore you out. By bedtime you’re yawning.
l2.fit.busy.dinner: The cousins stay all evening. Your after-dinner moment is full of cousins.
l2.fit.weekend: Weekends run differently. Your weekday moment doesn’t fit today.
l2.fit.sundaySnack: No school, so no after-school snack today.
l2.feel.1: Starting is a little easier now.
l2.opt.partyThen.cello: Party, then cello at your moment
l2.opt.partyThen.reading: Party, then read at your moment
l2.opt.luck.fix: Ask a grown-up to fix it
l2.opt.luck.ball: Kick a ball against the wall
l2.res.moment.cello.0: It takes a push, but you start. The cello was ready, and that helped.
l2.res.moment.cello.1: You pick up the bow. A little easier than last time.
l2.res.moment.cello.2: Your moment comes, and you play. Hardly any push now.
l2.res.moment.cello.3: Cello time. It just feels normal.
l2.res.moment.reading.0: It takes a push, but you open the book. It was right there, and that helped.
l2.res.moment.reading.1: You pick up your story. A little easier than last time.
l2.res.moment.reading.2: Your moment comes, and you read. Hardly any push now.
l2.res.moment.reading.3: Story time. It just feels normal.
l2.res.tired.cello: You play, yawning. Less sticks when you’re worn out, but you started.
l2.res.tired.reading: You read a page, yawning. You still started.
l2.res.other.cello: You play later. Your skills grow, but a different time still takes a push.
l2.res.other.reading: You read later. The story moves on, but a different time still takes a push.
l2.res.skip.cello: No cello today. That’s all it is: a missed day. Your skills stay, and so does Starting.
l2.res.skip.reading: No reading today. That’s all it is: a missed day. Your story waits, and Starting stays.
l2.res.slip.cello: No cello again. Starting slips back a little. It comes back when you do.
l2.res.slip.reading: No reading again. Starting slips back a little. It comes back when you do.
l2.res.rest: You rest. Rest is part of a good plan, so Starting stays where it was.
l2.res.restWeekend: A weekend off. Starting stays where it was.
l2.res.luck.cello: Not your fault. Strings break. A grown-up takes it to the shop, and Starting stays where it was.
l2.res.luck.reading: Not your fault. It happens. The book will be back tomorrow, and Starting stays where it was.
l2.res.gone: Your moment didn’t come today. Starting waits for the next one.
l2.res.soccer: Soccer happened. The coach and your lift took care of starting.
l2.res.trick: Lucky break: the new trick helps your passing.
l2.res.rain: No soccer today. Nobody chose the rain.
l2.check.heading: Is your moment working?
l2.check.word.all: {moment}: it worked every time it came.
l2.check.snag: On {days}, it didn’t come at all.
l2.check.ask: Keep it, or try another moment next week. Either is fine. A plan is something you can change.
l2.check.keepResult: You keep {moment}. Starting stays where it is.
l2.check.moveResult: From Monday: {moment}. Starting stays where it is. A new moment can take a few tries.
l2.plan.what: What will you start at home?
l2.plan.needs: Pick a moment and one thing to get ready first.
l2.end.heading: Starting got easier.
l2.end.journey.cello: At first, starting cello took a push. {stage, select, little {Now it’s a little easier.} easier {Now it’s getting easier.} normal {Now it feels normal.} other {It still does, and that’s all right.}}
l2.end.journey.reading: At first, starting to read took a push. {stage, select, little {Now it’s a little easier.} easier {Now it’s getting easier.} normal {Now it feels normal.} other {It still does, and that’s all right.}}
l2.end.why: That’s what a time and a place can do. When the moment came and things were ready, you didn’t have to decide all over again.
l2.end.whyStill: A time and a place can help. Starting gets easier the more often it happens at the same moment.
l2.end.skill: Starting is one thing. Playing well is another, and that still takes thought.
l2.end.time: In real life, this can take many weeks. It’s different for everyone.
l2.end.missed: And the day you missed? Just a missed day. You didn’t start over. You picked it up at the next chance.
l2.end.missedNone: And if you miss a day, it’s just a missed day. You don’t start over. You pick it up at the next chance.
l2.end.note: Just an illustration. Real life doesn’t come with a track.
l2.own.heading: Something you’d like to keep starting.
l2.own.text: Fill it in, print it and put it where you’ll see it. Nothing here is saved or sent.
l2.own.whatHint: Reading, drawing, a song on the piano
l2.own.missedHint: I start again at my next moment
l2.own.footer: It’s fine to change it. A plan is for trying.
l2.a.heading: Two weeks, one thing to start.
l2.a.text: You play soccer. The coach sets the times, and a grown-up drives you. That part is set up for you. One thing at home is up to you.
l2.b.heading: Room for two things a day.
l2.b.text: Each day has an after-school spot and an evening spot. Soccer takes some of them: the coach decides. Cello and the story you’re reading are up to you.
l2.b.ready: Get one thing ready for each.
l2.b.hint: Tap something to put it in a free spot. Tap a spot to empty it.
l2.b.res.moment: {Routine}, in its usual spot. Starting got easier.
l2.b.res.other: {Routine}, in a new spot. Starting moved only a little.
l2.b.res.skip: No {routine} today. Just a missed day: nothing lost.
l2.b.res.slip: No {routine} again. Starting slips back a little.
l2.b.res.gone: Soccer took {routine}’s usual spot. No chance today, so nothing lost.
l2.b.res.luck: A broken string. Not your fault, and nothing lost.
l2.b.check.heading: Which one is easier to start now?
l2.b.check.usual: {Routine} was mostly in the same spot: {slot}.
l2.b.check.ask: You can give each one a usual spot for next week, or keep juggling. Either is fine.
l2.c.heading: Plan your week.
l2.c.text: Soccer is already on the calendar: the coach did that. Give cello and your story a moment each, and get one thing ready. Then watch the week happen.
l2.c.playing: The days play by themselves. They stop when something happens.
l2.c.ask: Something’s different today. What do you do?
l2.c.partyGo: Go to the party, skip both tonight
l2.c.check.ask: Keep each moment, or move one for next week. Either is fine. A plan is something you can change.
l2.c.check.moved: {Routine} moves to {moment}. Starting stays where it is.
l2.res.skip.both: No cello, no reading. That’s all it is: a missed day. Your skills stay, and so does Starting.
l2.res.slip.both: Another day off from both. Starting slips back a little. It comes back when you do.
l2.res.other.both: You do both at a new time. Skills grow, but a new time still takes a push.
l2.res.rest.both: You rest from both. Rest is part of a good plan, so Starting stays where it was.
l2.res.restWeekend.both: A weekend off from both. Starting stays where it was.
